title: Runtime environment probes still use synchronous child processes
expected: Potentially slow child processes are asynchronous and bounded.
actual: Python and FFmpeg diagnostics use bounded asynchronous execFile calls.
reproduction: Open runtime diagnostics while a probe is slow
evidence: rg confirms no execFileSync usage in apps/desktop/src/main/main.ts
suggestedFixBatch: Move diagnostics probes to an asynchronous service.
acceptanceCriteria: No blocking probe on Electron main

title: Independent Codex review worker cannot authenticate
expected: An isolated reviewer can inspect local code without changing or exposing credentials.
actual: The configured Codex CLI provider exits before review because NINE_ROUTER_API_KEY is absent.
reproduction: Run codex exec --ephemeral -s read-only with the configured provider
evidence: codex exec exit 1 at 2026-07-30T11:50:00+07:00: Missing environment variable NINE_ROUTER_API_KEY
suggestedFixBatch: Configure an authenticated review provider outside this workflow, then rerun a read-only independent review.
acceptanceCriteria: Reviewer worker starts with read-only access
No secret is displayed or committed

title: CapCut editable draft cannot yet be verified in the installed application
expected: An editable draft opens in CapCut with visual, audio, and subtitle tracks preserved.
actual: The pycapcut bridge now creates structural video, audio, and subtitle tracks, but no CapCut-open verification exists and the production stage remains disabled.
reproduction: Run the local pycapcut structural fixture
Inspect generated video, audio, and text tracks
evidence: pycapcut 0.0.3 structural fixture: one video, audio, and text segment

title: Electron create-project smoke no longer reaches wizard content
expected: The create-mode renderer displays the project wizard.
actual: The smoke runner observed only Long/Short Factory.
suggestedFixBatch: Inspect renderer startup error and restore wizard rendering.

title: Local OmniVoice runner is unavailable
expected: The configured local checkout provides a runnable omnivoice-infer executable and its Python runtime.
actual: The checkout has deleted source files and no .venv/Scripts/python.exe or omnivoice-infer.exe, so Voice Generation stays gated without a provider fallback.
suggestedFixBatch: Restore or reinstall OmniVoice in its own checkout, configure the exact local executable, then run one explicit audio generation and FFprobe validation.
acceptanceCriteria: omnivoice-infer --help runs from the configured path
A manually initiated voice run produces FFprobe-valid audio inside the workspace
No alternate voice provider is used
